links.comparator_used: Fully manual delineation of liver, spleen and kidneys by medical physicists and radiological technologists (manual contouring without AI)
links.outcome: Total time required for dosimetry (image reconstruction, segmentation, absorbed dose calculation)
links.effect: Reference method (AI-seg modified by the most experienced MP) took 47.0 [30.0-58.0] min vs. 54.3 [49.5-67.0] min for manual, p = 0.014; DSCs for AI-seg were liver 0.988, spleen 0.965, kidneys 0.994 vs manual 0.955, 0.929, 0.929; kidney absorbed dose from AI-seg differed significantly (1.4% increase)
links.tradeoff: AI-seg HD exceeded 30.0 mm in a few cases (liver 3/23; spleen 2/23) due to hepatomegaly, so segmentation errors occurred and required correction; kidney absorbed dose from AI-seg differed significantly (1.4% increase).
links.quote: Dosimetry using the reference method took significantly less time than the manual approach (47.0 [30.0-58.0] min vs. 54.3 [49.5-67.0] min, p = 0.014).

design_hint: expert review and correction of AI segmentation outputs
